name: After § 17
title: REPORT on the EU strategy for the rights of persons with disabilities post-2024
part_text: 17a. Believes that the strategy for the rights of persons with disabilities post-2024 should lay down that all EU institutions, bodies, offices and agencies must ensure the full and consistent implementation of all the Ombudsman’s recommendations in order to underline the Ombudsman’s paramount role in protecting the rights of persons with disabilities;
